Quoniam quæ in tenebris dixistis, in lumine dicentur:

et quod in aurem locuti estis in cubiculis, prædicabitur in tectis.

So I say to you, my friends:
Ne terreamini ab his qui occidunt corpus,
Do not be fearful of those who kill the body,
et post hæc non habent amplius quid faciant.

et unus ex illis non est in oblivione coram Deo?

et capilli capitis vestri omnes numerati sunt.
You are worth more than many sparrows.
Omnis quicumque confessus fuerit me coram hominibus,
Everyone who will have confessed me before men,
et Filius hominis confitebitur illum coram angelis Dei:
the Son of man will also confess him before the Angels of God.
qui autem negaverit me coram hominibus,
But everyone who will have denied me before men,

And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of man,

ei autem qui in Spiritum Sanctum blasphemaverit,

Cum autem inducent vos in synagogas,
And when they will lead you to the synagogues,
do not choose to be worried about how

Spiritus enim Sanctus docebit vos in ipsa hora quid oporteat vos dicere.

Then he spoke to them using a comparison,
Hominis cujusdam divitis uberes fructus ager attulit:
“The fertile land of a certain wealthy man produced crops.
And he thought within himself, saying:
quia non habeo quo congregem fructus meos?
For I have nowhere to gather together my crops.’
I will tear down my barns and build larger ones.
et illuc congregabo omnia quæ nata sunt mihi,
I will gather all the things that have been grown for me,
And I will say to my soul: Soul,
habes multa bona posita in annos plurimos:
you have many goods, stored up for many years.
But God said to him: ‘Foolish one,
Stulte, hac nocte animam tuam repetunt a te:
this very night they require your soul of you. To whom,
So it is with him who stores up for himself,
et non est in Deum dives.
and is not wealthy with God.”
And he said to his disciples:
nolite solliciti esse animæ vestræ quid manducetis,
Do not choose to be anxious about your life, as to what you may eat,
nor about your body, as to what you will wear.
and the body is more than clothing.
For they neither sow nor reap;
quibus non est cellarium, neque horreum,
there is no storehouse or barn for them.
Quanto magis vos pluris estis illis?
How much more are you, compared to them?
Quis autem vestrum cogitando potest adjicere ad staturam suam cubitum unum?
But which of you, by thinking, is able to add one cubit to his stature?
Si ergo neque quod minimum est potestis,
Therefore, if you are not capable, in what is so little,
why be anxious about the rest?
Consider the lilies, how they grow.
nec Salomon in omni gloria sua vestiebatur sicut unum ex istis.
not even Solomon, in all his glory, was clothed like one of these.
if God so clothes the grass,
which is in the field today and thrown into the furnace tomorrow,
Et vos nolite quærere quid manducetis,
And so, do not choose to inquire as to what you will eat,

hæc enim omnia gentes mundi quærunt.
For all these things are sought by the Gentiles of the world.
Pater autem vester scit quoniam his indigetis.
And your Father knows that you have need of these things.
Yet truly, seek first the kingdom of God,
et justitiam ejus: et hæc omnia adjicientur vobis.
and his justice, and all these things shall be added to you.
Do not be afraid, little flock;
quia complacuit Patri vestro dare vobis regnum.
for it has pleased your Father to give you the kingdom.
Make for yourselves purses that will not wear out,
a treasure that will not fall short,
there will your heart be also.
et lucernæ ardentes in manibus vestris,
and let lamps be burning in your hands.
et vos similes hominibus exspectantibus dominum suum quando revertatur a nuptiis:
And let you yourselves be like men awaiting their lord,
when he will return from the wedding;
they may open to him promptly.
Beati servi illi quos, cum venerit dominus,
Blessed are those servants whom the Lord, when he returns,
quod præcinget se, et faciet illos discumbere,
that he will gird himself and have them sit down to eat, while he,
continuing on, will minister to them.
Et si venerit in secunda vigilia,
And if he will return in the second watch,
et si in tertia vigilia venerit,
or if in the third watch,
and if he will find them to be so:
quoniam si sciret paterfamilias, qua hora fur veniret,
that if the father of the family knew at what hour the thief would arrive,
et non sineret perfodi domum suam.
and he would not permit his house to be broken into.
quia qua hora non putatis, Filius hominis veniet.
For the Son of man will return at an hour that you will not realize.”

and he will place his portion with that of the unfaithful.

who knew the will of his Lord,
et non facit secundum voluntatem ejus,
and who did not prepare and did not act according to his will,

qui autem non cognovit, et fecit digna plagis,
Yet he who did not know, and who acted in a way that deserves a beating,
Omni autem cui multum datum est,
So then, of all to whom much has been given,
And of those to whom much has been entrusted,

et quid volo nisi ut accendatur?
And what should I desire, except that it may be kindled?

et quomodo coarctor usque dum perficiatur?

Putatis quia pacem veni dare in terram?
Do you think that I have come to give peace to the earth?
erunt enim ex hoc quinque in domo una divisi,

and a son against his father;
mater in filiam, et filia in matrem,
a mother against a daughter and a daughter against a mother;
and a daughter-in-law against her mother-in-law.”
And he also said to the crowds:
Cum videritis nubem orientem ab occasu,
“When you see a cloud rising from the setting of the sun,
And when a south wind is blowing,
You discern the face of the heavens,
hoc autem tempus quomodo non probatis?
yet how is it that you do not discern this time?
quid autem et a vobis ipsis non judicatis quod justum est?
And why do you not, even among yourselves, judge what is just?
Cum autem vadis cum adversario tuo ad principem,
So, when you are going with your adversary to the ruler,
in via da operam liberari ab illo,
while you are on the way, make an effort to be freed from him,
ne forte trahat te ad judicem,
lest perhaps he may lead you to the judge,
and the judge may deliver you to the officer,
et exactor mittat te in carcerem.
and the officer may cast you into prison.
you will not depart from there,
